projects.title: RTJ Rentals
projects.summary: RTJ Rentals provides exclusive corporate housing and short-term apartments for corporations, families, and individuals facing temporary displacement. With fully furnished, pet-friendly spaces in prime locations across Georgia and South Carolina, RTJ Rentals combines style, comfort, and functionality to create a home-away-from-home experience. Co-founded by Rodlyn and Tanya, the company focuses on personalized housing solutions, seamless insurance housing services, and an enjoyable stay for every guest.
projects.role: As the developer for the RTJ Rentals website, I designed a platform that highlights the company’s premium temporary housing options. The site offers an easy-to-navigate interface for exploring property details, checking availability, and understanding the unique benefits of staying with RTJ Rentals. My goal was to create a seamless user experience that reflects the company’s values of comfort and care.

projects.title: Villa Lapierrot
projects.summary: Villa Lapierrot is a stunning Provencal villa, nestled between the Dentelles de Montmirail and Mont Ventoux in the picturesque region of Provence. This recently renovated holiday home sits on a private, wooded plot of over 50 ares and offers tranquility, modern comforts, and scenic views of the surrounding countryside. The villa features 5 air-conditioned bedrooms, a spacious swimming pool, and a large terrace, providing the perfect getaway for families or groups of friends.
projects.role: As the web developer for Villa Lapierrot, my role involved designing and developing a visually appealing and user-friendly website that effectively showcased the villa’s luxurious amenities, serene environment, and proximity to local attractions in Provence. I created and organized content that highlighted key features like the recently renovated air-conditioned bedrooms, large swimming pool, gas BBQ-equipped terrace, and pétanque areas. Additionally, I implemented a seamless booking system that allows guests to check availability, view pricing, and make reservations easily. Ensuring responsive design for various devices and optimizing the site for search engines, I focused on attracting potential visitors by promoting the villa’s prime location, modern comforts, and tranquil setting amidst vineyards and oak trees.

projects.title: CGP Construction Corp
projects.summary: CGP Construction Corp is a trusted New York-based construction company. The website showcases a wide range of foundation repair techniques, from crack sealing to foundation stabilization, alongside creative and sustainable renovation strategies like repurposing materials and energy-efficient upgrades. Through its expert guidance and DIY repair tips, CGP Construction Corp empowers homeowners to take control of their renovation journey without compromising quality.
projects.role: As the web developer and designer for CGP Construction Corp, I was responsible for building a user-friendly, informative, and visually appealing website tailored to homeowners in need of affordable foundation and renovation solutions. My role included structuring the site to highlight DIY repair tips, creating a blog to provide practical renovation advice, and ensuring a seamless user experience. I also integrated SEO-friendly content to enhance the site’s visibility, helping CGP Construction Corp reach a broader audience of homeowners seeking cost-effective renovation ideas.

projects.title: La Côte De Beaune
projects.summary: La Côte De Beaune offers a premier delicatessen and catering counter service designed to delight both the eyes and the palate. Established by Michel and Thomas in 1994, the establishment blends their extensive experience with renowned Belgian and French cuisine to deliver a unique culinary experience.
projects.role: As the web developer and designer for La Côte De Beaune, I was responsible for crafting a sophisticated and user-friendly website that reflects the elegance and quality of the delicatessen and catering services. My role involved designing a visually appealing interface that highlights the gourmet nature of the offerings, integrates detailed information about the delicatessen and catering services, and features high-quality images of the dishes. I ensured that the website effectively communicates the unique culinary experience provided by La Côte De Beaune, while also facilitating easy navigation and access to service details, including contact information for catering inquiries and reservations.

projects.title: RedKey Logistics
projects.summary: RedKey Logistics LLC is a premier transportation provider offering comprehensive logistics solutions, including flatbeds, step decks, hot shots, dedicated box trucks, and specialized heavy haul services. With guaranteed capacity at major U.S. ports and access to over 50,000 vetted carriers, RedKey Logistics excels in providing timely and reliable freight solutions. The company specializes in truckload, less-than-truckload (LTL), intermodal, and specialized shipping, ensuring efficient and effective delivery for various transportation needs.
projects.role: For the RedKey Logistics website, I developed a streamlined platform that highlights their extensive transportation services and commitment to exceptional service. My role involved designing an intuitive site that showcases their capabilities in freight hauling and logistics, emphasizes their rapid response times, and provides easy access to information on their diverse shipping solutions. The site effectively communicates RedKey Logistics’ dedication to quality and efficiency in the logistics industry.

projects.title: Remodeling RF
projects.summary: RF Home Modeling is a leading home renovation company in Philadelphia, specializing in ceramic flooring, kitchen and bathroom remodels, painting, and more. Dedicated to quality and customer satisfaction, the company transforms spaces with precision, offering a seamless and stress-free renovation experience. Their services include full remodels, tile work, and various flooring options, aimed at creating beautiful and functional living spaces.
projects.role: For the RF Home Modeling website, I designed a clean, intuitive platform that showcases their extensive renovation services. My role included creating an engaging and informative site that highlights the company’s expertise in home remodeling. The site features easy navigation for service details and estimates, effectively communicating RF Home Modeling’s commitment to quality and customer satisfaction.

projects.title: Steri Clean
projects.summary: Stericlean is dedicated to providing top-quality cleaning and disinfection services specifically tailored for dental and medical practices. The company focuses on creating a clean and healthy environment to ensure the highest standards of hygiene and safety for healthcare establishments.
projects.role: As the web developer for Stericlean, I was responsible for designing and developing a website that effectively showcases the company’s specialized cleaning and disinfection services. The goal of the website is to provide a seamless experience for visitors seeking reliable cleaning and disinfection services, and to establish Stericlean as a leading provider in the healthcare cleaning sector.

projects.title: Joab Construction
projects.summary: JOAB Investment and Construction (U) Ltd is a leading full-service construction and investment company with over 15 years of experience in delivering high-quality construction services. The website reflects the company’s dedication to safety, efficiency, and quality workmanship, providing a platform where clients can learn about their services, explore past projects, and get in touch to discuss future endeavors. The company’s vision is to be recognized as the most reliable and trusted construction firm in the region, consistently delivering on-time, high-quality projects that exceed client expectations.
projects.role: As the web developer and designer for JOAB Investment and Construction (U) Ltd, I was responsible for creating a professional, engaging website that showcases the company’s construction services and investment opportunities. My role involved developing service-specific pages, designing a project portfolio, and integrating contact forms for easy client communication. I ensured the website is both user-friendly and visually appealing while maintaining responsiveness and search engine optimization to enhance visibility in the competitive construction industry.

projects.title: Tatiana Megard
projects.summary: The Tatiana Megard website is an elegant and minimalist online portfolio. The website reflects her artistic philosophy, where fashion is celebrated as a craft, focusing on physical materiality and sharp, abstract geometric lines. Visitors can explore her unique design portfolio, gain insights into her creative process, and see her latest collections that redefine classic clothing concepts with an avant-garde approach.
projects.role: As the web developer and designer for the Tatiana Megard website, I was responsible for creating a clean, visually appealing platform that aligns with her design ethos. My role included designing a sleek portfolio layout, integrating high-quality images of her collections, and ensuring seamless navigation. I also ensured the website is responsive and optimized for search engines to increase her visibility in the fashion industry.

projects.title: Carolina Custom Glass Works
projects.summary: Carolina Custom Glass Works is a specialized website designed to showcase premium glass solutions for both residential and commercial spaces. The website emphasizes custom glass craftsmanship, offering a variety of products such as custom shower enclosures, storefronts, windows, glass railings, and closet systems, tailored to enhance the aesthetic appeal and functionality of any space.
projects.role: As the web developer and designer for Carolina Custom Glass Works, I was responsible for building a visually appealing and functional website that showcases their custom glass solutions. My role included designing a clean, user-friendly interface, developing detailed service pages, integrating a portfolio section, and ensuring the site is responsive and optimized for SEO to attract and engage potential clients.

projects.title: Anytime Brokerage
projects.summary: Anytime Brokerage is a logistics and freight company offering customized solutions to streamline business operations. It ensures fast, reliable service by vetting carriers and maintaining compliance with safety regulations. Services include truckload, less-than-truckload (LTL), heavy-haul, and intermodal transportation, all designed to optimize the supply chain and enhance efficiency while ensuring transparency and customer satisfaction.
projects.role: As the web developer for Anytime Brokerage, I was responsible for creating a user-friendly website that reflects the company’s commitment to reliable and efficient logistics services. I developed an intuitive interface that allows clients to track their shipments, review carrier options, and manage their logistics in real-time. Additionally, I integrated advanced features for freight payment and compliance solutions, ensuring the site provided seamless access to essential tools and reports. The design was focused on transparency, allowing users to access all their order history and shipment information effortlessly.

projects.title: Domaine de La Haye
projects.summary: Domaine de La Haye, located in the picturesque region of Guerville in Normandy, spans over 200 hectares of lush woods and meadows. This serene estate offers visitors the perfect escape into nature, featuring sustainable forest management with diverse species such as beech, oak, Douglas fir, and maple. The domain is ideal for nature enthusiasts, with opportunities for forest walks, wildlife spotting, and cycling along beautiful trails in the Yères and Bresle valleys. The estate boasts Ravel-type cycle paths for safe travel through the valley.
projects.role: As the web developer and designer for Domaine de La Haye, I was responsible for creating an engaging and informative website that highlights the estate’s unique features and offerings. My role included designing a visually appealing site that effectively communicates the tranquil and historic nature of the property, while providing comprehensive details about the accommodation, natural environment, and nearby activities. I ensured the website was user-friendly, with intuitive navigation and easy access to reservation information, making it simple for visitors to plan their stay and explore the beauty of Domaine de La Haye.

projects.title: SteriLab
projects.summary: SteriLab is a premier provider of sterilization services for dental and medical instruments, dedicated to offering healthcare professionals a streamlined, efficient, and cost-effective solution for maintaining instrument hygiene. The website is designed to highlight SteriLab’s comprehensive sterilization process, which includes sorting, pre-washing, washing, disinfection, control, packaging, and traceability in accordance with current standards and legislation.
projects.role: As the web developer and designer for SteriLab, I was responsible for creating a clear, user-friendly website that effectively communicates the company’s sterilization solutions. My role involved designing the site to showcase the full range of services, including detailed explanations of each step in the sterilization process. I ensured the website was optimized for both functionality and aesthetics, providing a seamless user experience while highlighting SteriLab’s commitment to compliance and efficiency in instrument reprocessing.
